name: JMH Woodcraft Inc
old_description: New York City's Premier Custom Carpentry Design and Building Specialists
about:
JMH Woodcraft Inc. was founded in 1926 in New York City. The company has operated continuously as a custom carpentry and cabinetmaking shop serving both residential and commercial clients across the city.

The shop produces custom woodwork including kitchen islands, built-in bookcases, radiator covers, wall units, entertainment centers, and custom cabinets. Its services extend to stain matching, customized molding, antique restoration, total design integration, expert installation, and painting and repair. The company describes itself as a small operation that provides personalized service for projects of any scale.

JMH Woodcraft serves a mix of institutional, commercial, and residential customers. Notable commercial and institutional projects include work for Mount Sinai School of Medicine, Christ and St. Stephens Church, V&T's Restaurant, Firehouse Restaurant, Manhattan School for Children, Booker T. Washington Jr. High School, Beacon High School, and The Hungarian Pastry Shop. These references span healthcare, education, religious, and hospitality sectors.

The company emphasizes superior craftsmanship, attention to detail, clear communication, honesty, and integrity as its distinguishing qualities. It also highlights the ability to offer personalized attention on even the smallest projects, which larger contractors may not accommodate, and provides free consultations to prospective clients.
